entries.7ef049e96a5225f3: This reportable segment runs the restaurant business of "Anrakutei," which serves yakiniku at reasonable prices in open suburban spaces, and "Shichirinbo," a secondary core of the yakiniku division, which sets a higher average spend per customer than "Anrakutei" and offers meals in a calm setting with many private rooms. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥10,673 million (down 6.1% from the previous year) and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥274 million (down 40.8%). It is carried out by the company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries, and the number of stores at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 152 (107 directly operated stores, 11 noren stores and FC34 stores). The securities report states that at "Anrakutei" it worked on strengthening the "Meat Day Campaign" held around the 29th of each month, selling the "& (And) Yakiniku Series," and selling the branded wagyu "Matsusaka beef" only at its stores, and at "Shichirinbo" it focused on seasonal fairs and selling new banquet courses.

entries.d3faeafff7496b50: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,440 million (down 1.4% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥1,320 million (down 3.9%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥850 million (up 44.3%). The cost ratio was 38.1% (up 0.4 percentage points from the previous consolidated fiscal year), and the annual securities report attributes this to higher purchase prices of key ingredients such as meat and rice.
